title: Truth of the Sacrifice
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's hand touched the blood characters on the seven hundredth page of the Tianji Record, he finally understood—the so-called prophecy was never a free gift, but blood to feed the slumbering beast.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul hovered in the Void, and on that translucent face, images from ten thousand years ago emerged—blood-red sky, thunder clouds churning, an altar built from the flesh and blood of countless cultivators stood between heaven and earth. At the center of the altar, a blood-soaked figure knelt, clutching a scroll that radiated a dim, ethereal light.

"That was the first Master of the Tianji Record." Mo Xiansheng's voice arrived like echoes from antiquity. "He was the most devoted servant of the Heavenly Eye, yet he didn't realize that from the moment of his awakening, he had been chosen as the sacrifice." Chen Ji stared at the scene, something burning fiercely in his chest.

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Eye never sought the prophet, but the Chen family bloodline flowing through the prophet." The remnant soul spoke slowly. "The sacrifice ten thousand years ago should have succeeded, but at the final moment, Chen Nian, an ancestor of the Chen family, risked her life to interrupt it—she sealed a wisp of her soul into the Tianji Record, protecting the last page."

text.content: Chen Ji jerked his head up, his pupils contracting sharply. Chen Nian—the name of his missing sister, and the reason he could never clearly discern her fate's trajectory in the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng seemed to have anticipated his reaction, continuing calmly, "Your sister wasn't taken by the Holy Sect by chance. She is the final move set in place by the Heavenly Eye."

The scene in the Void shifted, revealing Chen Nian being escorted by Holy Sect cultivators. In those eyes, so like Chen Ji's, there was no fear—only resolve. And behind her, a faint blood-colored thread connected to some unspeakable existence in the distance.

dialogue.content: "Did you think the Tianji Record fragments were opportunities?" Mo Xiansheng's voice turned icy. "Each page is a nail, pinning you to the sacrificial altar. The more you use your prophetic abilities, the faster the sacrifice progresses. When you turned to the seven hundredth page—" The remnant soul paused, "—that was when the sacrifice officially began."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a surge of rage rise from his feet to the crown of his head. He recalled his seven hundred glimpses of the future, the seven hundred Heavenly Fate values consumed—so each "peek into Heavenly Secrets" was actually feeding his flesh to the abyssal beast called the Heavenly Eye.

dialogue.content: "What a fine Tianji Record." Chen Ji laughed, that smile more ghastly than crying. "What a fine Heavenly Eye." He clenched his fists, his knuckles blanching. "From the very first step I took into the cultivation world, I was calculated out to the last detail by you?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, then revealed an even crueler truth: "Your death prophecy on the seven hundredth page wasn't your destiny, but the trigger condition for the sacrifice. When the predicted time of your death arrives, and you happen to survive—this very contradiction will tear open the barrier between the Three Realms and the Heavenly Eye's origin."

Chen Ji's entire body froze. He recalled that prophecy: in seven days, he would die at the hands of Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect. Ridiculous—he had already orchestrated Han Lie's downfall before that, thinking he had rewritten his fate. Little did he know this was part of the sacrifice's design—only by escaping a destined death could the sacrifice take effect.

dialogue.content: "So the more I struggle, the faster I die." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "Every time I use the Tianji Record, I move one step closer to that outcome. And you—the Heavenly Eye—wait to collect the offerings of my Chen family bloodline and the world's fortune."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng didn't deny it: "The Heavenly Eye isn't an existence within the Three Realms. It's been trapped in this world for hundreds of millions of years and desperately needs the Chen family bloodline as a medium to break through the barrier. And you are the most suitable sacrifice in ten thousand years—your soul is resilient enough, your will strong enough to bear the cost of the sacrifice." He paused. "In other words, the stronger you are, the more perfect the sacrifice."

Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, the sound echoing through the empty Void, carrying an indefinable desolation and mockery: "Excellent scheming! Excellent methods! I've lived for over twenty years, thinking myself infallible, but I was nothing but a pig being fattened for slaughter!" His laughter stopped abruptly, cold flames kindling in his eyes. "Unfortunately—I have one flaw. I hold grudges."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rippled slightly, seemingly waiting for Chen Ji's decision. In the Void, that faint gaze of the Heavenly Eye grew increasingly intense, as if an invisible giant eye was gazing at this dialogue from the depths of the Void, examining whether this so-called "sacrifice" had any other value.

choice.prompt: After a brief emotional surge, Chen Ji quickly regained his composure. He realized that anger at this moment was meaningless—the truly strong are those who can find a way to break the deadlock in desperation. But this choice concerns the path he will take next.

choices.description: Abandon the use of the Tianji Record, sever the connection to the sacrifice, and seek another power system not dependent on the Heavenly Eye. This is a thorny path of cutting off one's own arms.
choices.visible_cost: Losing the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability
choices.visible_reward: Severing the Life Link with the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: After losing his greatest trump card, he will face encirclement and suppression from the three major sects and the Demonic Path.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, feeling the Heavenly Fate power within him drawn by the Tianji Record. If he severs the connection, he will lose the ability to foresee the future, but simultaneously—the beast parasitic in his life will lose its most crucial source of nourishment.
"I need to find another path." he said quietly, "One that doesn't require kneeling and begging heaven."

choices.description: Since the sacrifice binding is already in place, let's turn the tables—set up a counter-attack before the sacrifice is complete, letting the Heavenly Eye devour its own schemes. This requires more precise calculations and greater risks.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain information on vulnerabilities in the sacrifice process
choices.risk_hint: Every step is bargaining with a tiger, with extremely low margin for error

text.content: A ruthless glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Since the Heavenly Eye viewed him as mere livestock, he would play the role of the sacrificial pig—until the moment the blade fell, he would show this Heaven what it meant to meet one's match.

dialogue.content: "The sacrifice requires an offering, doesn't it?" Chen Ji suddenly smiled. "Then I'll give it a choice—to accept a flawed offering, or face the desperate retaliation of a sacrifice pushed to the brink."

choices.description: The core of the sacrifice lies in the binding between the Chen bloodline and the Tianji Record. If one could find a method to separate the bloodline from the Tianji Record, the sacrifice could be dismantled from its very root. This requires unraveling the secrets of the Chen family from ten thousand years ago.
choices.visible_cost: Revealing true intentions to the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: The possibility of unlocking hidden pages in the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye might initiate the sacrifice prematurely

text.content: Chen Ji's mind raced rapidly. The sacrifice bound the connection between the Chen bloodline and the Tianji Record—what if he could find a method to make this connection controllable, or even reversible?

dialogue.content: "If the Chen ancestor from ten thousand years ago could interrupt the sacrifice, they must have left a contingency." he murmured. "Chen Nian... sister... her being taken was definitely not a coincidence."

text.content: Just then, the gaze from the void intensified sharply. A boundless pressure surged from all directions, as if an invisible giant hand was reaching into this world from beyond the heavens, ready to crush Chen Ji along with this entire realm. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, hissing: "No good—it has sensed your wavering!"

dialogue.content: A cold voice emanated from the depths of the void, utterly devoid of emotion, yet striking Chen Ji's ears with tremendous force: "A mere ant dares to covet the secrets of the divine?" That voice was like Heaven itself delivering judgment, "Your fury has been received. But do you know—what was the fate of that Chen ancestor who interrupted the sacrifice ten thousand years ago?"

text.content: Chen Ji felt a chill climb his spine. The Heavenly Eye's presence was overwhelmingly strong, as if the entire world trembled beneath its gaze. What chilled him even more was that the entity seemed to know everything about him—including his most secret thoughts at this very moment.

"She has been sealed by孤 within the Heavenly Fate Lock, forbidden from rebirth for eternity." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried playful amusement. "And now, her blood descendant—your sister—is替孤guarding that very seal. Every time you use the Tianji Record, you inflict upon her the agony of ten thousand swords piercing her heart." A pause, "Interesting, isn't it?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's fists clenched so tightly that his fingernails cut deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers. His voice was dangerously low: "What have you done to Chen Nian?" Four words, each carrying a murderous intent, "Speak!"

text.content: The Heavenly Eye seemed to relish his fury, the pressure intensifying further: "Your sister is very strong. After enduring countless torments for ten thousand years, she has never surrendered. But what about you, Chen Ji?" That voice carried cruel amusement like a cat toying with prey, "Will you continue as孤's sacrifice, or watch her bear everything on your behalf?"

Chen Ji's blood and Qi churned violently, nearly erupting from his body. He felt his rationality being devoured by rage—that was precisely what the Heavenly Eye desired, wanted him to lose control, wanted him to burn through his Heavenly Fate in fury. Yet this very clarity forced him to suppress that surge of impulse.

dialogue.content: "I've记下了." Chen Ji's voice suddenly became calm, terrifyingly so. "The account from ten thousand years ago, today's account, every trace of pain you inflicted upon Chen Nian—I记下了 them all." He raised his head, his eyes burning with cold, ethereal flames. "You would do well to pray—before I have the ability to overturn this chessboard, that you don't give me any opportunity."

text.content: The pressure in the void abruptly stalled. The Heavenly Eye seemed unprepared for his rapid composure—this didn't fit the reaction a 'sacrifice' should have. After a moment of silence, that voice returned, carrying a hint of playfulness: "Interesting... you are unlike any previous Tianji Record masters. Perhaps you might truly provide孤 with some... surprises."

The pressure receded like a tide, but that gaze never truly vanished. Chen Ji knew from this moment on, there was no room for compromise between him and the Heavenly Eye—either you die, or I perish. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul finally exhaled, yet simultaneously revealed a bitter smile: "Chen Ji, your choices just now have been recorded by it."

dialogue.content: "From now on, every move you make is under its watchful gaze." The remnant soul's voice carried exhaustion. "But precisely because of this, your earlier words—'overturning the chessboard'—have made it产生 an 'anticipation' for you for the first time. This is your opportunity, but also the greatest danger."

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, once again suppressing the churning emotions into the deepest recesses of his heart. He looked at Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, his gaze carrying determination: "Since there's nothing left to retreat to, then there's nothing left to hide." He extended his hand, a phantom of the Tianji Record Fragment appearing in his palm. "Tell me—what exactly is the existence behind the Heavenly Eye, once the sacrifice is complete?"

The remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng let out a long sigh, seemingly hesitating whether to reveal the ultimate truth. After a long moment, he spoke: 'The Heavenly Eye is not the end. Beyond it exists an entity called 'Tiangang'—a higher-dimensional consciousness that formulates the operating laws of the Three Realms.' He paused, 'If the sacrifice is completed, 'Tiangang' will completely control the fate of the Three Realms, and then—'

dialogue.content: 'At that time, the billions of living beings across the Three Realms will all become chess pieces on 'Tiangang's' board, never to be freed.' The remnant soul's voice rang like a funeral bell. 'That includes you, Chen Ji, your sister Chen Nian, and everyone you wish to protect.'

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly. His expression gradually calmed—an ominous tranquility before the storm, the stillness of a wild beast sheathing its claws before launching an attack. He turned, gazing into the depths of the Void at that ever-present gaze, and smiled faintly.

dialogue.content: 'Very well.' Chen Ji said softly. 'Since that's the case, I have nothing left to hesitate over.' His voice was soft yet carried an iron-like will. 'You want to see a surprise? Then I'll give you one—before I personally overturn this chessboard, I will make 'Tiangang' understand what it means to lift a stone only to drop it on one's own foot.'

text.content: In the depths of the Void, that gaze seemed to ripple slightly—the Heavenly Eye was reassessing this being it had originally viewed as 'the sacrifice.' Chen Ji had already withdrawn his gaze, turning to Mo Xiansheng: 'The first scroll's objective, I have completed. What comes next?' His voice returned to its usual nonchalant tone, as if that earth-shaking declaration had merely been a comment on the weather.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul looked at the young man before him, a complex light flickering in his eyes. For ten thousand years, he had witnessed too many Tianji Record Masters collapse or go mad upon learning the truth, yet never had he seen one complete psychological reconstruction in such a short time and quickly map out a counterattack path. He suddenly felt that perhaps this time—it truly was different.

dialogue.content: 'The second scroll's objective—find your sister Chen Nian.' The remnant soul said slowly. 'She is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, also the key to breaking the sacrifice. But the Holy Sect... is by no means an existence you can challenge now. You need more chess pieces, more preparations, and—' he looked at Chen Ji, 'deeper fury.'

text.content: Upon hearing this, a cold smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. He gazed into the Void, as if peering through infinite distance to confront the Heavenly Eye: 'Fury? Fury is the one thing I have in abundance.' He said softly, 'You have nurtured my fury for over twenty years. Now—it is time to let it burn across the Three Realms.'

In the Void, the Heavenly Eye's gaze suddenly became intrigued. It seemed to be anticipating something, awaiting to see what kind of storm this ant who dared challenge the divine could conjure. Chen Ji had already turned around, stepping out of the illusory space Mo Xiansheng had constructed—the chess game belonging to him had officially entered its second scroll.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself still standing at the Cliff Edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. The night wind was biting cold, ruffling his robes. In the distance, the lights of Tianqing Sect twinkled like scattered stars, as if nothing had happened. But only he knew that from this moment, his destiny had been completely rewritten—no longer a lamb waiting to be slaughtered, but a Chess Player gathering strength to strike.
